definitions.expect: Proposed: a behavior-specific regression asserts term presentation, learner recall and immediate feedback in that order under the eventually selected interaction.
definitions.missing: scripts/recall-session.test.mjs is not present in the inspected scripts listing. Add the regression after the operator's open interaction choice supplies its concrete assertions. Intended red: removing the feedback transition must fail the assertion that feedback follows recall; a missing named file must fail rather than count as coverage. Requires the repository Node/pnpm versions.
definitions.source: Confirmed goal Done when; package.json:6-9,34-48 establishes Node test convention; .github/workflows/ci.yml:22-35 establishes setup; scripts/reveal-ui.test.mjs:1-5,15-41 shows UI assertion convention.
definitions.statement: A term is shown, the learner recalls it, and immediate feedback follows.
definitions.description: A term is shown, the learner recalls it, and immediate feedback follows.

definitions.expect: Proposed: behavior-specific assertions establish that completing recall neither schedules later work nor creates a spaced-repetition obligation.
definitions.missing: The widget and its state boundaries have not been selected or implemented; identify those boundaries and add explicit no-scheduling assertions. No separate runnable invocation is established yet.
definitions.source: Confirmed goal Must not; package.json:34-48 supplies the Node test convention, but no scheduling-exclusion regression was established.
definitions.statement: The widget excludes spaced repetition and scheduling anything for later.
definitions.description: The widget excludes spaced repetition and scheduling anything for later.

definitions.expect: Proposed: existing ink-cue assertions pass. This does not verify visual clearance. Intended targeted red: allowing a mastered expression or a score-bearing cue must fail the existing malformed-value rejection assertions.
definitions.statement: Existing ink cue boundaries remain bounded and cosmetic.
definitions.description: Existing ink cue boundaries remain bounded and cosmetic.

definitions.how_to_judge: Proposed, not performed: inspect the implemented recall interaction and immediate-feedback states at desktop and mobile sizes, with keyboard interaction, reduced motion and WebGL fallback. Inspect paper/ink appearance and absence of pills, counters and boxes. Confirm the ink remains usable and uncrowded throughout. Browser tooling availability and actual rendering remain unverified.
